units.source_text: 下午，松树的影子落在对局室的拉窗上。

en.t: In the afternoon, the shadows of the pine trees fell across the sliding doors of the game room.
White-eyes flew in, chirping and warbling.

units.source_text: 大鲤鱼在房檐下的泉水里游来游去。

en.t: Large carp swam back and forth in the spring water beneath the eaves.

units.source_text: 箱根奈良屋旅馆喂养的是锦鲤，这家旅馆是黑鲤。

en.t: At Hakone's Naraya Inn they kept ornamental koi, but at this inn the carp were black.
